ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهِ وَطَهِّرْنَا مِنَ الْأَدْنَاسِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Wa ṭahhirnā mina ‘l-adnās.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family and purify us from filth!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهِ الَّذِيْنَ أَزَلْتَ عَنْهُمُ الْأَرْجَاسِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Alladhīna azalta `anhumu ‘l-arjās.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family those who on whom impurities vanish!
blocks.review: الْأَرْجَاسِ: final vowel is printed as kasra (accusative fatḥa would be expected); transcribed as printed (rhyme vowel).

ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهِ الَّذِيْ لَمْ يَرْضَ بِلِيْنِ الْفِرَاشِ .
tr: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Alladhī lam yarḍa bi līni ‘l-firāsh.
en: O Allah send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family who preferred not the softness of a bed!
